_description: Burden Event parameter schema — wired from burden-event-keyed.json (DON-81 / Gate 2-2). Systems Designer validation: DON-87.

A.title: The Stillness
A.note: Audio-visual only. No narrative text displayed.

B.title: The Witness

variants_first.title: The Holding
variants_first.text: Three keepers of their own small truths. You hold them now. That is the burden.

variants_first.title: The Silence
variants_first.text: Three echoes, and the world is quieter for their leaving. You carry what remains.

variants_first.title: The Cost
variants_first.text: Three bearers, each walking their own uncertain path. That path ends with you.

variants_repeat.title: The Doubling
variants_repeat.text: More echoes. The world does not forget.

B.template_first: {count} {collective_noun} of their own small truths. You hold them now. That is the burden.

C.title: The Choiceless Choice
C.legend_line_template: Burden acknowledged — {run_count} spectral echo added to next encounter.
C.mechanical_note: Next room: one fewer enemy, replaced by a spectral echo (cosmetic).

entries.trigger: MORAL_FLAG >= 3 reached at least once in run
entries.template: The Keeper carried {count} {collective_noun}. The burden was borne.

entries.trigger: MORAL_FLAG >= 3 reached twice in same run
entries.template: The Keeper carried {count} {collective_noun}, then more. The burden deepened.

entries.trigger: MORAL_FLAG = 0 at run end (all enemies spared)
entries.template: The Keeper laid down no weight. The path remained light.

caption_triggers._description: Caption timing offsets and curves per Audio Director review DON-220. All offsets are seconds from transition start. Tolerance ±0.2 s per DON-225.

bd_climb._description: BD-CLIMB stem configuration for per-stem width-modulation caption alignment.

localization.context: The apparition is the voice of the world itself, mourning deaths the player has caused. Second-person present during the event; third-person past in Legacy Archive.
localization.note: Avoid idioms that do not translate literally. Abstract metaphors of carrying, holding, and silence travel better.
